labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Asks when external contributors can open pull requests, which is a contribution-process question.

items.body:
Pull requests and contributions are covered in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md). The expected route is to describe the change in an issue first, so a maintainer can review the approach before a pull request is opened.

If the broken link is in the root documentation, an issue naming the broken link and the page it appears on is the most useful next step. A related earlier report is #4029.

Questions about project policy are best asked in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
